subsection.name: Introduction
subsection.p: This library integrates the Meet video-conferencing service with Lutece through the IVirtualMeetingProvider interface defined by the module-appointment-virtualmeeting module.

ul.li: OAuth2 authentication against the Meet external API
Meeting URL generation from a configurable URL pattern and the room slug

subsection.p: Unlike token-based providers (e.g. LiveKit), Meet uses a single room URL shared by all participants. The generateParticipantToken() and generateViewerToken() methods return this room URL directly.

subsection.name: Configuration
subsection.p: Configure the library in the file WEB-INF/conf/plugins/meet.properties:

tr.td: Base URL of the Meet external API
Email address of the user to delegate
URL pattern for the Meet web frontend. The placeholder {slug} is replaced with the room slug at runtime.

subsection.name: Usage
subsection.p: Add the Maven dependency to your site POM:
The library is automatically discovered as an IVirtualMeetingProvider by the module-appointment-virtualmeeting module through Spring bean detection. No additional wiring is required.

When VirtualMeetingService calls getParticipantMeetingUrl() or getViewerMeetingUrl(), the Meet provider relies on the default interface implementation which delegates to generateParticipantToken(), returning the room URL built from the configured pattern and slug.
